title: When the House Sings
author: J. M. Eastwick
blurb: Vesper Ravensworth, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
